articles.title: Nike, Army Honor 4th Infantry Division With ‘Ivy Soldier‘ Football Uniforms for 2026 Army-Navy Game

articles.summary: Nike FIT, short for Functional Innovative Technologies, is Nike’s performance-apparel system designed to help eliminate distractions and provide more comfort and freedom to stay in the moment. First introduced in 1991, FIT has evolved through athlete testing, material innovation and sport science research into four distinct technologies that scale across sports: Dri-FIT to help athletes stay dry, Aero-FIT to help them stay cool, Therma-FIT to help them stay warm, and Storm-FIT to help them stay protected.
articles.title: Explainer: What Nike Dri-FIT, Aero-FIT, Therma-FIT and Storm-FIT Actually Do
